top_signals.title: AI, data center alarms dominate Congressional Black Caucus week in Washington
top_signals.summary: AI interests pro and con turned out for the Congressional Black Caucus's annual gathering in Washington as the topics — plus redistricting concerns — dominated.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Union Says US Steel Talks Make Little Progress Ahead of Deadline
top_signals.summary: The United Steelworkers accused US Steel of “petty” negotiating tactics as talks with the Japanese-owned company entered a critical stretch, saying they have made little progress on key issues.
